description: Karl Deisseroth received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for pioneering optogenetics. Following the announcement, he swiftly returned to his family routine by preparing sandwiches for his children. His wife, Dr. Michelle Monje-Deisseroth, was less surprised by the news due to Karl's work ethic. Their son, Alexander, and teenage children expressed pride in their father's achievement.
title: “My dad is relentless”: Meet Nobel winner Karl Deisseroth’s family and kids

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Chetan Bhagat, speaking at the 18th Project Management South Asia Conference in Bengaluru, highlighted the significance of concentrated work. He suggested that only four hours of focused effort could lead to effective productivity, challenging the conventional belief that long hours equal high output. Bhagat connected work-life balance to overall happiness, advocating for personal needs, thus enriching the ongoing dialogue regarding ideal working hours in India.
title: Chetan Bhagat says 4 focused work hours a day can be enough

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: DeKalb County has approved an initiative to transform the empty Presidential Hotel into modern market-rate apartments. This $53.3 million project will feature 282 residential units, including studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom layouts, with expected completion by the end of next year. Local residents have welcomed this development as a major enhancement to the community's housing options.
title: Atlanta’s Presidential Hotel could become 282 apartments in $53.3m plan

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Ben Hogan, once a bike mechanic, established Project Bike Leg with a vision to fabricate prosthetics from recycled bicycle components. His mission is to aid impoverished amputees worldwide who struggle to find affordable prosthetic options. Through engaging instructional videos on his website, Hogan empowers others to create their own bike legs.
title: Former bike mechanic turns discarded bicycles into prosthetic legs

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: 'Drishyam 3: The Conclusion' stands on the brink of entering the prestigious Rs 200 crore domestic net club on Day 5, boasting an impressive Rs 199.78 crore cumulative collection so far. Despite experiencing its first standard weekday drop with Rs 21 crore net on Day 4, the Ajay Devgn and Tabu starrer maintains an unbeatable pace. With worldwide gross surpassing Rs 303 crore, the thriller now sets sights on Rs 225 crore and Rs 250 crore milestones.
title: 'Drishyam 3 The Conclusion' BO Day 5 [LIVE]: Ajay Devgn film closes in on Rs 200 crore India net mark

author: DHRUV YADAV
description: India is currently conducting simultaneous military exercises with multiple nations to strengthen defense relationships. Exercise Yudh Abhyas with the United States focuses on high-altitude warfare, while Exercise Mountain Guardian involves the UAE in mountain operations. KAZIND with Kazakhstan and Nomadic Elephant with Mongolia also highlight India's growing military diplomacy. These activities improve interoperability and expose Indian troops to diverse military practices.
title: Four nations, four drills, one month: How the army is expanding its military partnerships

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: UIDAI has introduced a revised Standard Operating Procedure for updating names in Aadhaar that began on September 18, 2026. The updated rules categorize name changes into minor and major with specific documentation requirements. Minor corrections can be made with standard proof of identity while significant changes need a Gazette Notification. Individuals can generally update their Aadhaar name twice before needing further approval.
title: UIDAI announces new SOP for changing name on Aadhaar, here's what you need to know

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Children frequently display physical affection towards their parents, such as gently touching their faces while talking. This interaction not only nurtures a sense of closeness but also helps them assess their parents' engagement. Studies indicate that such affectionate gestures are crucial for emotional growth throughout childhood. Parents must recognize the importance of these moments while also upholding appropriate boundaries to enhance emotional safety and deepen the parent-child relationship.
title: Why children touch a parent’s face while talking, according to psychology

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: The ECB could provide financial support to Cricket West Indies to ensure England’s women play a Test in the Caribbean next spring. The match is viewed as vital preparation for the 2027 Ashes, with England seeking more red-ball cricket. Despite CWI’s financial difficulties and recent cost-cutting measures, the Test and wider multi-format tour remain on schedule.
title: 'We all have huge sympathy': Why England cricket ready to fund West Indies Test

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Aravind Srinivas overcame significant educational hurdles after failing to meet the cut-off at IIT Madras. Taking charge of his learning, he self-taught programming and excelled in competitive challenges. Following successful internships at top AI research facilities, he co-founded Perplexity AI in 2022. Now, at just a young age, he boasts a remarkable net worth of $2.1 billion, showcasing his unwavering resilience and hard work.
title: Missed IIT by 0.01, rejected by MIT: Meet Perplexity’s Aravind Srinivas

title: Trump blames Iran for flydubai incident, Vance 'defers', says 'nothing conclusively yet'

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In response to rising diesel prices, US President Donald Trump has enacted an executive order designed to alleviate financial pressures across multiple sectors. This order is anticipated to substantially cut fuel costs for farmers and truck drivers, ultimately contributing to lower grocery prices. Additionally, it urges states to expand access to tax-free red-dyed diesel and consider lifting specific fuel taxes.
title: Trump signs order to ease diesel costs, ‘save millions of dollars’ for farmers

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: Oil prices are currently around $100 a barrel as stable Middle Eastern exports ease supply concerns. However, ongoing regional conflicts, including Houthi attacks, raise risks of disruptions. Officials indicate that rebuilding global oil stockpiles could take years due to significant withdrawals. Industry executives predict that demand recovery may not occur until 2028 or 2029. Prices may stabilize at around $70 a barrel depending on future production levels.
title: Oil prices hover near $100 as Middle East supply holds up, Gulf risks persist

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: Yemen's Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for missile and drone attacks targeting Saudi Arabia's infrastructure. The reported strikes included key sites such as airports and an Aramco refinery. In response, Saudi-backed Yemeni forces have intensified their offensive against the Houthis along the Red Sea coast. The conflict has prompted Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Türkiye to activate their defense pact for collective response.
title: Houthis target Aramco refinery, Saudi capital airport as Mecca defence pact activated

author: MANUJA VEERAPPA
description: More than 100 women gathered at the Kyoto City Budo Centre to practice sumo wrestling. Despite historic resistance, female participation in sumo is increasing, with over 600 women involved in various clubs. The Japan Sumo Association does not recognise women's sumo, leaving many to rely on private clubs for training. Coaches and athletes express hope for future Olympic inclusion as they work to build awareness.
title: In Japan, women’s sumo battles tradition and a male-dominated system for survival

title: Jeffrey Archer, author and former British politician, dies at 86

title: New York declares disaster emergency over measles, 108 cases reported

description: Stock market recommendations: Dixon Technologies, GAIL, and Prestige Estates Projects have been identified as the top stocks to sell by  Somil Mehta, Head of Retail Research, Mirae Asset ShareKhan on October 6, 2026.
title: Which are the top stocks you should buy or sell today?

author: TNN
description: A video showing utensils being washed on a toilet floor at New Delhi Sweets raised significant concerns. The footage, shared on social media, prompted a food safety inspection by officials in Korba. During the inspection, the operator claimed this was due to an emergency water supply disruption. Food safety officer Sangharsh Kumar Mishra labeled the practice as unhygienic and a clear violation of norms.
title: Video: Staffer washes utensils in toilet at sweet shop; food dept issues notice

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: In the sixth instalment of TimesofIndia.com's series looking back at India's medal-winning campaigns at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Koneru Humpy opens up about playing through illness to help the women's team win bronze. The 39-year-old reveals how diarrhoea and stomach pain forced her to take medicines and play almost every day. Humpy also discusses the physical demands of playing 10 of 11 rounds, Vaishali's struggles, her busiest stretch of the season and what lies ahead.
title: 'Taking medicines every day': How Humpy battled diarrhoea to win medals for India

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: In a shocking crackdown, police in Ho Chi Minh City apprehended a network of 12 individuals linked to an alarming cat theft and trafficking operation. Around 2,700 cats were reported stolen from local neighborhoods, with the suspects capturing these beloved pets under the cover of darkness to sell them as meat. The investigations unveiled a long-standing illegal operation, allowing authorities to act swiftly.
title: Cat meat trade: 2,700 cats stolen in Vietnam for meat; police bust suspected theft ring

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: A laboratory employee at Russia's Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute has tested positive for an infection, raising alarms over possible internal contagion. Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, noted that the US is actively observing the scenario as reported by Russian sources. Quarantine actions have been initiated, yet the exact infection details are not disclosed.
title: Russia plague scare puts US on watch as Rubio flags possible internal spread

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN AND PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A fire broke out at the temporary labor accommodation near Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport, injuring two workers during the evacuation process. The blaze ignited around 6:50 am, swiftly overtaking the PVC panel structure. Firefighters successfully controlled the flames after 40 minutes, despite two explosions from LPG cylinders that occurred. Initial investigations revealed that the fire started while workers were cooking.
title: Major fire guts labour camp outside Lucknow airport

title: Punjab govt to move SC against CBI probe into Mann's OSD over graft claims

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Hardik Pandya recently joined MrBeast and CarryMinati to recreate his iconic shrug celebration from the T20 World Cup. MrBeast visited India and shared his experiences, including photos with several celebrities. Pandya expressed his desire for MrBeast to return to India soon with a friendly message. The shrug celebration became famous after India's victory in the 2024 T20 World Cup final against South Africa.
title: Hardik Pandya's famous celebration returns, this time with MrBeast and CarryMinati

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: In a nuanced twist, South Korea has been sending considerable quantities of diesel fuel to Russia even as it lends support to Ukraine amidst the ongoing invasion. Recent months have seen multiple shipments, indicating a complex dynamic between the two nations. Notably, this fuel trade continues despite South Korea's promise to aid Ukraine with essential military support and humanitarian assistance.
title: Fueling both sides? South Korea ships 150,000T fuel to Russia while funding Ukraine

author: SAURABH THAKUR
description: A consumer commission in Delhi has ordered a hospitality club to reimburse a customer a sum of Rs 1.75 lakh after the club failed to deliver promised membership perks, including a complimentary plot in Maharashtra. In addition to the refund, the commission awarded Rs 1 lakh for mental distress and Rs 50,000 for legal costs.
title: Country Club promised plot with membership but never gave it; ordered to pay Rs 3.25L

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Kovid Ajay Gangrade proudly represented India by securing a silver medal in the Digital Interactive Media Design category at the WorldSkills Shanghai 2026. His achievement, a result of nearly a year of intense preparation, not only highlights his talent but also signifies a boost for the country's standing at the competition. Gangrade hopes his victory will inspire youth to explore and engage in skill competitions.
title: Meet Kovid Ajay Gangrade, MP student who won silver at WorldSkills Shanghai

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: WeWork co-founder Adam Neumann says the collapse of his $47 billion company began during a 30-minute car ride with SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son in 2016. Speaking on The Diary of a CEO podcast, Neumann said Son's $4.2 billion investment offer fed his ego and made it "about the money." He also discussed WeWork's failed IPO, Chapter 11 bankruptcy and his new real estate startup, Flow.
title: Adam Neumann says a car ride with Masayoshi Son started WeWork's $47 billion collapse

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Restoration efforts in South San Diego Bay converted former salt ponds into functional tidal wetlands. Wildlife has shown significant recovery with 80 species of birds, 22 species of fish, and 10 species of invertebrates observed. The project aimed to restore natural tidal flows and enhance habitat diversity. Native plants began emerging quickly after the restoration, indicating ecological recovery.
title: California restored 300 acres of salt ponds; 80 bird species later recorded

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Research conducted at the Etowah Indian Mounds has revealed cacao residue in 11th-century pottery, illustrating that the Mississippian culture actively consumed cacao as part of their lifestyle. This discovery suggests interconnected trade networks similar to those seen in Chaco Canyon, hinting at shared cultural exchanges. The distinct pottery styles from Etowah further emphasize this cultural interaction, prompting further investigation into these ancient societies.
title: Ancient pottery reveals earliest known chocolate traces east of Mississippi

title: Bengal bypolls: AJUP chief Humayun Kabir detained in Murshidabad after casting vote

author: ARYAN SINGH
description: The United States is set to assess four cutting-edge directed energy weapon systems designed specifically for drone defense. Under a new pilot program focused on directed energy, these technologies—prominently high energy lasers and high powered microwaves—will be tested. The goal is to bolster military proficiency by crafting robust counter-drone solutions, showcasing a strategic shift towards innovative approaches to combat emerging aerial threats.
title: No missiles, no bullets: US picks 4 weapons to destroy drone swarms at light speed

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Sujeet Kalkal's Asian Games gold came two years after floods in Dubai cost him a chance to qualify for the Paris Olympics. The 25-year-old wrestler fought back from 2-9 down to beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the 65kg final, ending India's eight-year wait for a wrestling gold at the Games. Now targeting Los Angeles 2028, Kalkal says he does not want to go to the Olympics just to participate - he wants gold.
title: Sujeet Kalkal on turning Olympic heartbreak into Asian Games gold

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: The assessing officer made two major additions in this case. The first, Rs 1,93,78,293, was treated as long-term capital gains on the ground that the man had converted a capital asset into stock-in-trade. The second, of Rs 2,20,98,985, was treated as business income arising from the alleged sale of that stock-in-trade.
title: Man gets flats under builder deal, transfers 5 to wife; gets Rs 4.14cr tax notice

title: 'More skeletons are tumbling out': Cong trains guns at EC over new report on Bengal polls

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: John Stankey, AT&T's CEO, critiques SpaceX's ambitious claims regarding Starlink's competition with established telecom players. He argues that the logistical and financial challenges of entering the mobile carrier landscape are significant hurdles. Meanwhile, AT&T continues to innovate in fiber infrastructure to provide high-speed internet, casting doubt on Starlink's potential to effectively challenge traditional networks. This ongoing rivalry highlights a transformative shift in how communication services are delivered.
title: As Elon Musk targets mobile industry, AT&T CEO says Starlink’s plan ‘doesn’t line up’

author: MD. DILSHAD
description: A 14-year-old student left his home in Firozabad to complete a PUBG gaming task. His family reported him missing after he failed to return home. Police used CCTV footage and mobile tracking to locate him three days later in Indore. Officers reunited the boy with his family and urged parents to monitor children's online activities. Previous incidents of children leaving home for gaming tasks have occurred in other regions.
title: Teen leaves home for ‘1L PUBG task’, found asleep on bus 3 days later

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India women’s captain Harmanpreet Kaur has stepped down from captaincy in all formats, bringing an end to her stint as the team’s leader. Harmanpreet said the decision was not easy but felt she had fulfilled her responsibility as captain.
title: 'I have done my duty': Harmanpreet Kaur steps down as India captain

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Earlier this year, Travis and Jason Kelce quietly donated $10,000 to help a Team USA hockey star’s family travel to Milan for the 2026 Winter Olympics. The contribution supported a $50,000 fundraiser created after the family struggled to afford the trip. Travis also offered encouragement before the Olympic debut, while Jason and Kylie attended the gold-medal game. Team USA eventually defeated Canada 2-1 in overtime for gold.
title: Travis and Jason Kelce donated $10,000 to help Laila Edwards’ family reach Olympics

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Brittany and Patrick Mahomes have been an inseparable duo since their high school days, building a resilient bond over the years. Their relationship has been a cornerstone of Patrick's journey in the NFL, keeping him humble and focused amidst the spotlight. As proud parents of two children, they've gained a new appreciation for life and football.
title: How Brittany Mahomes helped Patrick Mahomes stay grounded as an NFL star

author: ARVIND CHAUHAN
description: Lucknow has faced flooding in several neighborhoods due to upstream rainfall runoff. Local rainfall alone is not responsible for the resulting waterlogging in the city. Officials indicate that the runoff from upstream catchments has taken about eight to ten days to reach Lucknow. Urbanization and encroachment on the river's floodplain have exacerbated the flooding situation. Experts expect gradual improvement as runoff emissions begin to stabilize in the coming days.
title: Lucknow floods: Why city got flooded days after the rain stopped

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: The word 'Roger' has its origins in early military radio communication, symbolizing the letter R and indicating that a message has been received. Its adoption simplified phrases for quick comprehension during transmissions, evolving into a term of competence in popular media. 'Roger that' has since become a common confirmation phrase, though its meaning remains intact.
title: Why do people say 'Roger that'? Who was Roger?

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has achieved over Rs 300 crore in worldwide gross collections shortly after its release. Following a strong opening weekend, the film saw a significant drop in earnings on Monday. Its total net collection in India reached Rs 197.50 crore, while overseas collections contributed an additional Rs 66 crore. The film recorded nearly 8 million footfalls across India within the first four days of its release.
title: Drishyam 3 dips on Day 4, crosses Rs 300 crore worldwide

author: TNN
description: Negotiations regarding the bilateral trade agreement between India and the US have stalled, reaching a plateau. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that both sides face difficulties in making further concessions. The US aims to reduce its trade imbalance with India, while recent laws have complicated matters. Discussions included tariffs impacting agricultural imports and energy purchases from the US.
title: India-US trade talks have reached plateau: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman

author: SIDHARTHA
description: Proposed changes to the GST regime are expected to benefit businesses, improving cash flow and refunds. A refund on accumulated GST for input services and capital goods may help manufacturers significantly. The GST Council will discuss the rationalization of ITC, which has long been an issue for businesses. Decriminalization of certain GST provisions aims to create a more business-friendly environment in India.
title: Proposed GST changes positive for business: Experts

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: Delhi government modified an order regarding duty charges of 12 police officers after harassment allegations surfaced. Assistant Commissioner of Police Vivek Bhagat voluntarily stepped aside from his additional charge as the inquiry continues. The CDC assignment began prior to the allegations, ensuring it does not indicate a promotion. The complaints have been transferred to the Crime Branch for a detailed investigation and fair inquiry.
title: Delhi Police ACP's additional DCP charge withheld amid harassment inquiry

author: NITESH DUBEY
description: Virat Kohli is 15 centuries away from becoming the first batter to reach 101 international hundreds, with ODI cricket now his only route to Sachin Tendulkar's record. India have 11 confirmed bilateral ODIs before the 2027 World Cup, while the Asia Cup offers additional opportunities. A possible six-match South Africa series in the new FTP could give India further preparation before the World Cup, but the century chase remains a difficult one.
title: 86 to 101: Kohli's final ODI window to break Tendulkar's century record

author: TUSHAR TERE
description: During this year's Navratri, vadodara's garba events have embraced luxury, offering participants premium packages that promise comfort and exclusivity. Attendees can enjoy benefits like valet parking, VIP seating, and personalized services to enhance their experience. Special packages are also available for non-resident Indians and out-of-state guests seeking convenience. Meanwhile, Ahmedabad is stepping up with high-priced options, indicating a broader shift toward exquisite and lavish festival celebrations.
title: Garba’s new luxury flex: Valet, VVIP seats and butlers

author: LISA MONTEIRO
description: Bombay High Court recently questioned the Election Commission regarding the removal of Indian citizens from electoral rolls. The court highlighted the importance of ensuring only citizens are on these rolls during special revisions. Justices emphasized that the process must not result in falsely excluding eligible voters. The Election Commission's guidelines and requirements for form submissions were scrutinized for being inadequate. The hearing on this matter will continue in subsequent sessions.
title: 'If SIR excludes citizens from voters list, what is its purpose?': Bombay HC to EC
